configuration.mixer: Disjoint partial swaps of positions i and n-1-i; exact isometry to one binary orientation per pair
configuration.support: 2**floor(n/2) complete routes, NOT n!; odd center position fixed; global optimum not necessarily reachable
configuration.cost: Original directed road objective folded exactly to binary-chain unary and pairwise terms using integer Decimal input arithmetic
configuration.baseline: Exact minimum over the same matching orbit by classical linear chain DP, evaluation only; no quantum novelty claim over this baseline
configuration.fit: basis:9 embedded-p1 beta points, coherent:4 gamma x3 beta points; two COBYLA starts max24 each; <=64 unique evaluations
configuration.numeric_scope: Small independent exact permutation/qubit controls, accumulated truncation norm, cross-cutoff convergence; not full interval floating-point certification
configuration.rollout_gate: All correctness, precision, resource, seed-stream and replay checks pass. Quality improvement is reported, not required to publish a negative-result cohort.
configuration.inferential_scope: Seed intervals conditional on each input;26 parent groups retain dependence across scenario variants; single fixed configuration, no broad QAOA advantage claim

configuration.support: All n! customer permutations, independently certified return feasible; ideal uniform initial permutation state
configuration.training: Reuse unchanged p1 uniform cost pool on main cohort; independent pools on representative training-seed repeats
configuration.optimizer: Analytic last beta, two COBYLA starts x32 function calls, embedded p1 and split initialization; <=68 unique evaluations
configuration.final_validation: n<=25: existing exact complex subset DP; n>25: shared independent uniform MC prefix over all characteristic frequencies
configuration.MC_confidence: Simultaneous complex Hoeffding union over all queries and all3 predefined sample sizes; optional refinement is covered
configuration.numerical_phase: Complex Taylor16 on reduced |x|<=1/8 plus repeated squaring, explicit conservative IEEE bound and route-cost/angle error
configuration.state_precision: Unitary telescoping norm-error propagation; normalized-state trace upper<=.01 and infidelity<=.001; independent-PRNG/IEEE assumptions explicit
configuration.rng: PCG64 with separate SeedSequence components for input/layers/training/validation/measurement
configuration.resource_failure: If error gate still fails at the predefined third precision, no performance value is promoted and full rollout remains unqualified

configuration.method: Adjacent parity swap p3; active-label MPS rank64, explicit truncation bound
configuration.optimizer: Deterministic three-point grid t={0,.5,1}; gamma fixed, all beta scaled by t; choose conservative upper expected energy
configuration.scope: Restricted angle search, no continuous or global angle optimum claim. Approximation errors conditional on floating-point residual model.
configuration.seeds: Independent PCG64 measurement streams; deterministic training has no training seed; seed0 replayed exactly
configuration.invalid: Count all invalid raw outcomes; never repair or resample. Best feasible draw reported with invalid count.
